source_chart.custom_filter_oracle: Exact RowAuth.dfsSubmit serializer object. Root/group/leaf field sets are frozen; deep-equality includes empty dynamicTimeSetting on group and leaf. Copy excludes transient field object and copies all serialized members.

shared_chart_fixtures.note: The complete LINE-1 and LINE-2 target states exist before events; switching active_target does not synthesize a target fixture.

shared_worker_transport.worker_lifetime: while at least one same-origin app tab is connected; volatile memory only
shared_worker_transport.rejection_rule: uid, oid, sessionEpoch mismatch or worker unavailable => no payload delivery and clipboard remains unavailable
shared_worker_transport.logout_rule: CLEAR_SESSION from any authenticated tab clears volatile state for that session across all connected tabs

response_binding_contract.comparison: exact equality for every listed field, plus equality to current active target state immediately before publish
response_binding_contract.parameterized_cases: The expanded cases CPI-041..052 instantiate one case for each of all 12 capture fields including requestId; exactly one response field differs, with all remaining tuple members equal. Each dispatch/result/stage/commit event repeats the same stable request_id and full tuple digest.
response_binding_contract.tuple_digest: capture_digest is SHA-256 of canonical JSON over all 12 ordered fields; fixtures also retain the full tuple values to avoid digest-only substitution.
